item_name: Rothco ANSI Ballistic OTG Goggle System
item_short_desc: Rothco’s ANSI OTG Goggle System offers superior eye protection with versatile functionality. Designed to fit over prescription glasses or sunglasses, these goggles feature 2mm thick polycarbonate lenses that meet ANSI-Z87-1 and MIL-DTL-43511D standards for impact protection. 3 interchangeable lenses—yellow for improved contrast, smoke for UV blocking, and clear for general protection—adapt to various environments. The goggles are equipped with anti-scratch coating, UV 400 protection, and top/bottom vents to prevent fogging.
description: Rothco’s ANSI OTG Goggle System offers superior eye protection with versatile functionality. Designed to fit over prescription glasses or sunglasses, these goggles feature 2mm thick polycarbonate lenses that meet ANSI-Z87-1 and MIL-DTL-43511D standards for impact protection. 3 interchangeable lenses—yellow for improved contrast, smoke for UV blocking, and clear for general protection—adapt to various environments. The goggles are equipped with anti-scratch coating, UV 400 protection, and top/bottom vents to prevent fogging. Moveable hinges ensure a snug fit with helmets, while foam padding provides long-lasting comfort. Includes a cleaning cloth, protective cover, and a convenient hook-and-loop carry pouch.
